s01.defect: The brown wrist tab with its grommet and brass brad sits as a visible collar over the forearm's cut end. The forearm shows a hard straight bottom edge behind the tab, and there is a slight width step from the forearm to the wider hand.

s02.defect: The hand hangs off the side of the tab: the palm sits to the left of the forearm axis and the tab sticks out to the right as a lone rounded lobe. The yellow brad is offset from the grommet hole, so the pivot doesn't line up. The arm and hand don't read as one limb.

s03.defect: A brown leather tab rises from the boot shaft onto the shin like a tongue. The brad is off-centre from the grommet, and there is a big width step: the boot shaft and tab are narrower than the shin, whose rim shows on both sides.

s04.defect: A straight diagonal scissor cut removes the whole right shoulder of the torso, from the collar to the right edge. The face is blank, with no eyes, nose or mouth, only a beard outline. The head is tilted on a thin neck tab that shows a cut rim at the collar.

s05.defect: A rectangular brown wrist tab shows as a collar with a cut edge, and the brad sits below the grommet instead of in it. The forearm cuff's straight end is visible behind the tab. The hand and forearm still read as one arm.

s06.defect: Half of the shin's gold grommet peeks out above the boot top at the left. The boot's brad sits on the elastic panel, well away from that grommet. There is a step in width at the join: the shin's tan rim shows wider on the left than the boot.

s07.defect: The same straight diagonal cut removes the torso's right shoulder. The neck tab is a square cardboard collar with a visible rim at the jacket collar, and the head is tilted. The gold dots on the brows and cheeks look like extra pivot holes stuck on the face.

s08.defect: This is the best of the set, with no diagonal cut. The neck ends in a flat rectangular tab whose bottom edge is a hard horizontal cut sitting over the jacket collar, a clear width step from neck to tab. The stray gold dots on the face are also still there.

s09.defect: The boot is rotated so far that the toe points up and back toward the knee, which is an impossible ankle angle. The boot's black tab overlaps outside the shin outline, and the brad is offset from the grommet.

s10.defect: The square tab at the wrist shows a cut rim. The brad is off-centre from the grommet, and the fist is attached at the side of the tab instead of continuing the forearm, so the wrist break looks abrupt.

s11.defect: This has the same defect as s06: half a gold grommet sticks out above the boot top, the brad sits on the boot body rather than at the pivot, and the shin's rim shows wider than the boot at the join.

s12.defect: The head is rotated about 60° on a narrow neck stub, which is an impossible tilt, and the face is blank skin with no features. A straight diagonal cut slices off the whole right side of the torso.

s01.defect: A pasted face patch has its cut outline showing as a pale box around the eye, cheek and mouth. The neck ends in a dead-straight horizontal scissor cut at the collar, and the grommet is half covered by it. There is a skin-coloured sliver beside the right collar edge.

s02.defect: Clear gap between the rounded shin end and the boot top, with a white halo under the shin. The boot shaft is cut flat across the top and is wider than the shin. The boot is grey/white while the shin is black, so they don't read as one leg.

s03.defect: A white triangular wedge pokes out at the left side of the neck. A half gold grommet sticks out under the chin, which suggests the brad isn't on its grommet. The face patch outline shows (box edges at the brows and beard). The neck is chopped and sits too narrow on the collar.

s04.defect: A white halo/rim runs round the shin's rounded end where it overlaps the boot. The shin lands on the back of the boot shaft, not centred, which leaves a width step on the left.

s05.defect: A white rectangular notch is cut out of the forearm's right edge just above the wrist. The hand's black cuff tab sticks out as a separate collar with its own grommet. The hand is far wider than the forearm.

s06.defect: A square skin-coloured tab with a grommet sticks out above the hand like a luggage tag. There is a big width step from the narrow forearm to the wide fist.

s07.defect: The brad sits off-centre in its grommet, leaving a gold crescent showing. The hand's round tab bulges past the forearm edge (tab showing). The hand is about twice the forearm's width and hangs at an awkward sideways angle.

s08.defect: A white halo shows under the shin end. The boot hangs behind and to the left of the shin at an awkward angle, and its shaft top is hidden but the join reads as two stuck-on pieces. The grommet is oversized and sits right at the edge.

s09.defect: A straight scissor-cut step runs across the right shoulder/collar, with a white rectangle missing from the jacket at the right of the neck. A half grommet peeks out under the chin. The face patch outline shows across the face. The head floats with almost no neck, and the chin covers the collar.

s10.defect: The neck ends in a straight horizontal cut with a white gap. The torso is rotated so the armhole and grommet face the camera, which is an impossible orientation against a profile head. The face patch outline shows. The neck is narrower than the collar opening, so it doesn't read as the same body.

s11.defect: Best of the set, but a thin white rim shows under the shin end. A dark brown gusset/tab fills the boot opening between the shin and the boot (cut edge showing). The boot is wider than the shin, a slight width step.

s12.defect: The forearm is a stubby rectangle with a skin-coloured tab and big grommet at the top, so the mounting tab is fully on show.
